quarterly_data.signal: INmune Bio and QCi announced a collaboration - a Stage 1 engagement with options for additional work - applying QCi's Dirac-3S quantum optimization machine together with AI and data analytics to INmune Bio's pre-clinical and clinical datasets to identify new potential indications and biomarkers for XPro (XPro1595); QCi says it is its first commercial customer in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology market.
